criteria.name: Price
criteria.description: Cost of a family plan covering four users

options.name: Bitwarden
options.summary: Open-source manager with published audits and a 6-user family plan

options.name: 1Password
options.summary: Polished, audited, Secret Key design; pricier

options.name: NordPass
options.summary: Cheap promo family plan, 6 users, audit details thin

options.name: RoboForm
options.summary: Cheapest family plan, no reported breach

scores.rationale: No verified claim on Bitwarden breach history in sources
Published Cure53 results and multiple independent audits
Unlimited free tier; family price $40 or $47.88/yr (conflict) either way low
Secret Key design; no breach claims verified either way
Regular published audits, SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001
Highest list price among main options, no free tier
Six accounts at low promo price; renewal rises
No reported breach in 25 years per two sources

recommendation.headline: Bitwarden Families is the best fit for audits and price
recommendation.summary: Open source, publishes independent audit results, supports all three platforms and costs well under other family plans.

reasons.text: Publishes Cure53 audits and is independently audited multiple times
Unlimited free tier and low family price

tradeoffs.text: Less polished UI than 1Password; family price figure disputed

alternatives.when: You will pay more for polish and the Secret Key design
You want simplicity at promo price

caveats: Bitwarden breach history not covered by sources
Most sources are review sites, some affiliate

contradictions.assessment: Source 8 states prices verified Sept 2026 against vendor pages; source 2 is dated 2023 and its reliability dropped, so $47.88 is likelier but unconfirmed.

uncertainties.text: No source covers Bitwarden's breach history
Keeper no-breach claim comes from Keeper's own blog

uncertainties.howToResolve: Verify current prices on vendor sites
